rationale: The advisory lists Enterprise 10.0 bundled Node.js as affected, 9.4 and 10.2+ as unaffected by that component issue, and UF as unaffected. Visual Exporter has a separate disable/remove mitigation. Automation Broker, Observability Cloud and OpenTelemetry Collector remain affected with remediation in progress. Synthetic Runner’s documented 1.71.0+ recommendation applies to that component only.
